project.title: Module4
project.description: Module 4: Doctor’s Guidance – The Bigger Picture Created in Storyline 360, this module continues Ravi’s journey through storytelling, where a doctor character joins to provide insights and guidance. Narration is paired with voice-over synchronized text animations to enhance learner focus. Interactive elements such as click-to-reveal activities, hotspots, tab interactions, and drag-and-drop exercises encourage exploration and reinforce understanding. By blending narrative with interactive discovery, this module helps learners see the broader context of smoking’s impact and the path toward healthier choices. Delivering Level 2 interactivity, it balances storytelling with knowledge application for an engaging learning experience.
